text: Upgrade Proof is a tool for teams that review npm upgrades. It proves each upgrade in a disposable Vultr sandbox.
say: Upgrade Proof is a tool for teams that review npm upgrades. It proves each upgrade in a disposable Vulture sandbox.

text: An upgrade pull request often says tested locally. It shows no proof.
Also, npm install runs package scripts with your environment. A hostile script can read your tokens and send them out.
This is the agent workspace. It runs on Vultr Cloud Compute in Seoul.
say: This is the agent workspace. It runs on Vulture Cloud Compute in Seoul.

text: The demo project uses chalk 4. Its test helper has a hostile postinstall script. We ask for chalk 5.4.1.
say: The demo project uses chalk 4. Its test helper has a hostile postinstall script. We ask for chalk five point four point one.

text: First, Vultr Serverless Inference reads the package file and writes a plan. The plan flags the hostile script before any install runs.
say: First, Vulture Serverless Inference reads the package file and writes a plan. The plan flags the hostile script before any install runs.

text: Each step runs in a new Docker container. The baseline tests pass. Then the agent installs chalk 5.
The tests fail. Chalk 5 is ESM only, so chalk dot green is not a function.
The agent sends the test log and the source files to the model. The model returns a fix. The agent tests again.
The fix replaces the chalk calls with a small color helper. Now the tests pass.
Now look at network containment. The hostile script tried to connect to an outside collector two times.
The egress proxy blocked both calls. The sandbox had no secrets to send.
The verdict is upgrade proven. The full run took 26 seconds.
The evidence bundle holds the diff, each test log, the blocked calls, and a SHA-256 manifest. A reviewer can check each file against the manifest.
You can also give a public GitHub URL. Here, the agent upgrades mocha 3 to 10 in a real open source package. The tests pass with no change.
The sandbox drops all Linux capabilities. It uses a read-only root and a non-root user. Its only exit is a proxy to the npm registry.
Vultr runs the whole loop. Cloud Compute hosts the agent and the sandboxes. Serverless Inference writes the plan and the fix.
say: Vulture runs the whole loop. Cloud Compute hosts the agent and the sandboxes. Serverless Inference writes the plan and the fix.

text: Many teams get dependency pull requests every week. Upgrade Proof turns each one into a checked result with proof.
Today it supports npm and one run at a time. Next, we will add a GitHub App and more package managers.
Upgrade Proof. Don't trust the upgrade. Prove it.
